answer: A Hardware security key bound by DNS record proof with a ninety-day rotation cooldown turns a private channel into public evidence: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. A hollow out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its channel clears. When the meadow settles over the mesa, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
